remarks:
Welcome to 311 Traverse Blvd – offering four bedrooms, flexible living space and plenty of storage throughout!

On the first floor, two bedrooms, a full bath and a bright living room w/exposed hardwood flooring provide the option for single-level living. An eat-in kitchen (refreshed 2021) offers gray cabinetry, a stone backsplash and peninsula w/breakfast bar along w/a suite of stainless steel appliances. The full bath (updated 2023) features a navy vanity w/solid-surface countertop, brushed gold hardware, tub w/tile surround and luxury vinyl plank flooring.

Upstairs offers flexible space w/two additional bedrooms joined by a large hallway landing w/room for exercise equipment. A separate room currently used as a walk-in closet provides excellent storage and could also serve as a small fifth bedroom or possibly a second-floor full bath w/capped water lines already in place.

The basement features a poured foundation w/glass block windows and offers bonus space including a recreation room w/dry bar, workshop area, laundry and half bath. Mechanical updates include a new hot water tank (2026), boiler (2018) w/three zones of heating, central air and 150-amp electrical service.

Outside, a concrete driveway leads to a detached 2.5-car garage w/concrete floor, opener and lofted 
storage. Both the house and garage have new architectural roofs (2024) w/a transferable warranty.

Close to restaurants, grocery stores and everyday amenities, this solid starter home sits in a neighborhood setting w/the Rails to Trails nearby and Hoover Elementary and Middle School just a short walk away. 

Showings begin Saturday, October 10th @ 10am!
